thesis: Alibaba Group is a China-based technology holding company operating multi-sided commerce, cloud computing, and international retail platforms. **[Fact]** FY2026 revenue was **RMB 941.2 billion** (approximately **US$148.4 billion**), down **5.5%** versus FY2025. **[Fact]** The group reports four operating segments for FY2026: **Alibaba China E-commerce Group** (Taobao, Tmall, quick commerce), **Cloud Intelligence Group**, **Alibaba International Digital Commerce**, and **All others** (Cainiao, Freshippo, DingTalk, Qwen consumer, media). **[Fact]** One American depositary share represents **eight** ordinary shares. **[Fact]** Cash and equivalents were **RMB 145.5 billion** and equity-method investments **RMB 210.2 billion** at March 31, 2026. **[Fact]** The company uses a **variable interest entity (VIE)** structure so Cayman-listed shareholders do not directly own the operating companies in China.
why_market_wrong: **Predictive attribute:** complexity discount (VIE legal structure, China ADS geopolitical overhang, segment restructuring, and a negative reported free cash flow year during an AI capex cycle).
